units.source_text: 左中弁看见源氏自己无意接受，心念朱雀院来意非常诚恳，

en.t: The Middle Counselor of the Left saw that Genji himself had no intention of accepting, and thought that Suzaku-in's purpose in coming was deeply sincere,

units.source_text: 若以上述之言复告，定然使他伤心失望，

en.t: and if he reported Genji's earlier words back to him, it would surely leave him hurt and disappointed,

units.source_text: 于是再把朱雀院私下决定的计划详细奉闻。

en.t: so he once again explained in detail the plan that Suzaku-in had privately decided upon.

units.source_text: 源氏听了，不觉莞尔一笑，答道：“

en.t: When Genji heard this, he could not help smiling gently and replied, "

units.source_text: 朱雀院如此偏怜三公主，对她的前途考虑得真周到啊！

en.t: Suzaku-in is so partial in his affection for the Third Princess, and he has considered her future with remarkable care.

units.source_text: 我看最好把她送入冷泉帝宫中。

en.t: In my view, the best course would be to send her into Emperor Reizei's palace.

units.source_text: 宫中早有几位身份高贵的女御，然而不必担心，

en.t: There are already several high-ranking consorts in the palace, but there is no need to worry,

units.source_text: 她们未必是三公主前途的障碍，有道是‘后来居上’呀。

en.t: for they will not necessarily stand in the Third Princess's way; as the saying goes, those who come later may rise above those before them.

units.source_text: 桐壶院时代，弘徽殿太后是帝为太子时首先入宫的女御，

en.t: In the time of Kiritsubo-in, the Kokiden Empress Dowager was the first consort to enter the palace while the emperor was still crown prince,

units.source_text: 权势极盛，然而有一时期竟被后来入宫的藤壶母后所压倒。

en.t: and her power was at its height, yet for a time she was actually eclipsed by Fujitsubo, who had entered the palace later.

units.source_text: 三公主的母亲藤壶女御，与藤壶母后为姐妹。

en.t: The Third Princess's mother, the Fujitsubo Consort, was the sister of Fujitsubo.

units.source_text: 世人都称两人容貌一般美丽。

en.t: People said that the two sisters were equally beautiful in appearance.

units.source_text: 则三公主不论肖似母亲或姨母，其相貌一定也很不凡。”

en.t: So whether the Third Princess resembles her mother or her aunt, her looks must surely be extraordinary."

units.source_text: 此时他想象三公主的容貌，一定心驰神往。

en.t: At this moment, as he imagined the Third Princess's beauty, his heart must surely have been carried away.
